<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 可取得

門檻來自社群觀察，並非完整官方規格。啟用設定後，私人貢獻也可能計入。

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

建立獲得 **16 顆星**的儲存庫；更高等級取決於同一儲存庫的星數。

**等級:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (儲存庫星數).

[實際範例](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

作為作者提交 **2 個已合併的 PR**。

**等級:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (作者的已合併 PR).

[實際範例](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

在 **1 個已合併的 PR** 中共同撰寫提交，正確使用 `Co-authored-by`。

**等級:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (共同撰寫的已合併 PR).

[實際範例](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

在 Discussions 獲得 **2 個被採納的回答**。`github.com/orgs/community` 自 2024-02-06 起不再授予。

**等級:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (已採納回答).

[實際範例](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="quickdraw"></a>
### Quickdraw

<img src="../assets/badges/quickdraw-default.png" width="96" alt="Quickdraw">

在建立後 **5 分鐘內**關閉 issue 或 PR。

[實際範例](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S25](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="yolo"></a>
### YOLO

<img src="../assets/badges/yolo-default.png" width="96" alt="YOLO">

**未經程式碼審查**合併自己的 PR；官方未公布詳細資格規則。

[實際範例](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S26](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="public-sponsor"></a>
### Public Sponsor

<img src="../assets/badges/public-sponsor-default.png" width="96" alt="Public Sponsor">

透過 **GitHub Sponsors** 公開贊助開發者或組織。

[實際範例](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=public-sponsor&tab=achievements) · [S27](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=public-sponsor&tab=achievements) · [S19](https://github.com/sponsors) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="retired"></a>
## 🕰️ 歷史成就

活動已結束；已授予的徽章可以保留，新貢獻無法解鎖。

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

為 **2020-02-02 Arctic Code Vault 快照**中的合格儲存庫貢獻程式碼。快照已關閉。

[實際範例](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<a id="mars-2020-contributor"></a>
### Mars 2020 Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

為 **NASA/JPL Ingenuity** 使用的指定專案版本提交程式碼。活動已結束。

[實際範例](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=mars-2020-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="experimental"></a>
## 🧪 實驗中 / 已停用

GitHub 確認 2026 年 3 月的重新啟用是錯誤；未公布正式開放日期。

<a id="heart-on-your-sleeve"></a>
### Heart On Your Sleeve

<img src="../assets/badges/heart-on-your-sleeve-default.png" width="96" alt="Heart On Your Sleeve">

與 ❤️ 反應有關的實驗；2026 年 3 月的錯誤開放已撤銷。現在新增反應並非已確認的取得方式。

[S07](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/190746) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="open-sourcerer"></a>
### Open Sourcerer

<img src="../assets/badges/open-sourcerer-default.png" width="96" alt="Open Sourcerer">

與多個公開儲存庫中的已合併 PR 有關的實驗；精確計數與資格規則未公開。

[S07](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/190746) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

## 🔒 GitHub 內部獎勵

這些獎勵對應內部 Proxima 里程碑；沒有公開取得方式或確認的停止授予日期。

<a id="proxima-pioneer"></a>
### Proxima Pioneer

<img src="../assets/badges/proxima-pioneer-default.png" width="96" alt="Proxima Pioneer">

[實際範例](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-pioneer&tab=achievements) · [S10](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-pioneer&tab=achievements)

[實際範例](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-staffshipper&tab=achievements) · [S11](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-staffshipper&tab=achievements)

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ 個人資料標記

Highlights 是獨立的計畫或帳號標記；是否能取得取決於對應計畫。

| 名稱 | 狀態 | 條件 | 來源 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | 可取得 | 使用 GitHub Pro。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | 可取得 | 加入 GitHub Developer Program 並使用 GitHub API 開發應用程式。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | 可取得 | 透過漏洞獎金計畫回報符合條件的 GitHub 安全漏洞。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | 可取得 | 參與 GitHub Campus Experts；請查核目前的申請規則。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | 可取得 | 在 GitHub Advisory Database 的已接受安全公告中獲得貢獻認可。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | 可取得 | 入選 GitHub Stars；儲存庫星數本身無法解鎖此標記。 | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | 歷史成就 | 歷史上的 Discussions 已採納回答標記；社群於 2022 年回報其被 Galaxy Brain 取代。 | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |

### Proxima 案例

截圖與卡片一致：Pioneer 是 M0 原型貢獻，Staffshipper 是 M8 實例部署，Staffuser 是團隊加入。

| 成就 | 帳號 | UTC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Proxima Pioneer](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-pioneer&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2023-06-01T17:34:35Z |
| [Proxima Staffshipper](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-staffshipper&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2024-08-21T22:28:27Z |
| [Proxima Staffuser](https://github.com/timrogers?achievement=proxima-staffuser&tab=achievements) | @timrogers | 2023-08-16T18:28:07Z |
